title: Choose the visual world for Beams & Braces
question: Safer round, keeping the old site's warmth. Pick one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: The Timber Yard Ledger
options.lineage: The 1987 family wood yard: stock ledgers, timber tickets, oiled brass fittings
options.thesis: The old dark-and-brass world, grown up: warm bog-oak sections, oiled brass, a light serif carrying dates and numbers like ledger entries.
materials: light serif display with italic brass accents
options.viewport: A full-bleed curved-deck photo under a deep bog-oak wash. 'Not everyone needs a premium deck.' in a large light serif, brass italic on one word, with Let's Chat and WhatsApp beneath. The credentials run as a ledger line along the bottom edge.
options.risk: Closest to the category's premium default. It wins on warmth and continuity, not on surprise.

options.label: The Broads Boatyard
options.lineage: Norfolk Broads boatyards: varnished mahogany hulls, gold-leaf sign-writing, brass cleats
options.thesis: Craft you'd find in a Wroxham boatyard: dark varnished timber, gold-leaf serif lettering and brass hardware, framing real waterside decks.
options.viewport: A deep varnished-dark hero holding a waterside deck photo. The headline is set like sign-written gold lettering, the credentials sit like a brass builder's plate, and Let's Chat is a solid gold button.
options.risk: Can slip into nautical theme-park if the lettering or brass details are overdone.

options.label: The Board Showroom
options.lineage: A timber merchant's showroom wall: real board lengths, sample chains, specification cards
options.thesis: The real boards lead: large photographs of all 13 colours and finished decks in a calm, warm-neutral showroom, with a serif voice and brass details.
options.viewport: The hero splits between a finished deck photo and a tall rail of real board samples. Picking a sample recolours the caption. The headline and Let's Chat sit beside it.
options.risk: Leans towards selling the material, where the brief says to sell Darren. Needs his voice up front.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Premium decking as Trex UK, Millboard and top garden designers ship it: darkened hero photo, serif headline, gold CTA, badge strip, range cards, review carousel.
canonCard.viewport: A darkened hero photo with a centred serif headline and two buttons.
canonCard.risk: Polished but indistinguishable from competitors, and close to the current site.
